You will take full ownership of the sales function, from strategy through to the number on the board, working directly with the leadership team to shape how the company sells across the UK, Germany, France and the US as it moves into its next stage of growth. You will drive rigorous use of HubSpot to manage the customer lifecycle, from first enquiry through to handover, and use that data to sharpen conversion at every stage. You will identify and manage strategic partnerships that widen how customers first experience the product, including test-ride and demonstration programmes, and work closely with marketing, operations and customer experience to keep the whole commercial engine aligned. You will coach and develop your team, represent the brand at trade shows and events, and challenge existing processes wherever they slow growth down. As the company expands into new markets, so does the scope of this role, with the chance to build a sales organisation from the ground up and grow with it internationally.

review_candidates.title: Course Writer and Editor: UX, UI, and AI
review_candidates.description: You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed that you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it . You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand. Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world. A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean. You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world. If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow. The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman , as well as Design Leads at Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe . You’ll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow . Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast. Your Role at IxDF Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create educational content for people worldwide . You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills in timeless, human-centered design and AI . Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds. The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure. You don't need a design background. Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs. Write for a diverse, global audience. Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge. Be the voice of IxDF. Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours. Represent a global movement dedicated to design education , and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one. Set and raise the standard for our assessments , so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both. Balance the big picture with the smaller details. Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy. About You You have at least 4 years of professional writing or editing experience. What matters far more than the number is the quality of the work you can show us: a course, an article series, a set of scripts, documentation, a newsletter. We’re excited to hear what it was, why you wrote it the way you did, and how long it took you to create. You're a master communicator with a sharp eye for detail and strong skills in language, tone, and flow . You can take a complex idea and write it so a beginner gets it on the first read. You know how to hook someone with a title and a first line, and you know the difference between a hook that's earned and a hook that's cheap. You collaborate with AI in everything you do . You use AI to write, research, and create faster, and you know how to take human leadership , so the outcome is 100% yours and better than you could have created without AI. You’re eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know they’re more relevant than ever in the age of AI. You can write for a career changer and for an experienced designer without losing either one. You have an exceptional talent for creating structure , and you take pride in organizing processes and tasks in a way that's efficient and clear. You're genuinely curious about UX and UI design, and you're motivated to learn how great design shapes experiences and solves problems. You're genuinely curious about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work. You're kind, and you have the social intelligence and empathy to engage well with very different kinds of people. You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy. You take full ownership of your work and see it through. You move comfortably across ad hoc projects of varying complexity, and you stay consistent when the work turns repetitive. You’re enthusiastic about learning by doing and are committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills . You spot problems before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report. You’re driven by the desire to make a positive impact in the world and to improve the lives of others. You're located in a time zone between UTC+0 (London) and UTC+4 (Dubai), which covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Bonus Points None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier. You've taught in classrooms or workshops , or you've created educational material . You have your own blog or social media page where you create and share original content. You’ve collaborated with video production teams . You've written quiz or assessment questions. You've worked with an LMS or an online learning platform . You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in communications, journalism, literature, or a similar field. What We Can Offer A highly valued role: You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes. Reach and impact that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. Your words will be read year after year, by hundreds of thousands of people who build better careers and design a better world for all of us. An education you can't buy: free access to every IxDF course and Master Class, and a job that requires you to study the work of the best designers alive in order to edit it. Most people pay for this. You'll be paid for it. Access: the designers whose books you'd normally buy are the people whose words you'll be shaping, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with. Studio shoots: once you know our courses well, usually after your first year, you'll be a real asset on a studio production, and you'll be welcome to join us when we meet our experts in professional studios around the world. Some of us love that part and go every time; others keep travel to a minimum. Both work for us. On average we shoot 4-6 new courses per year. Autonomy : Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses read. A global, purpose-driven team: work remotely alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by a common mission to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone. A full-time position within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or for a studio production. Bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work. A work culture with no fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama . Your colleagues value your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver . If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF. A daily mission to help impact, empower, and enrich the lives of millions of people by creating affordable high-end design education for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too. Colleagues with four to forty years of experience , and a culture where we follow the best idea, not the longest résumé. We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at the forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it . You'll help set a direction that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world. review_candidates.description: Strategic CFO is a consulting company that partners with growing businesses across Texas and the United States. Each Controller is assigned to a dedicated NearSourcing™ client, serving as an integral part of that client's finance team. This is a full-time, remote position based in Colombia or Mexico. Applicants MUST have a valid passport and a current U.S. visa, as international travel to Houston, Texas is required for onboarding and quarterly thereafter. Candidates who do not currently possess both a valid passport and a valid U.S. visa will not be considered. The Opportunity: We're looking for a practical, proactive, and highly coachable Controller with exceptional technical accounting knowledge. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and communicates effectively with professionals at all levels of an organization.As part of one of our NearSourcing™ teams, you'll work exclusively with a single client, becoming a trusted member of their finance organization while collaborating with Strategic CFO professionals. This role requires in-depth knowledge of construction accounting, including the Percentage of Completion (PoC) revenue recognition method and Work-in-Progress (WIP) management. The Controller is also responsible for supervising the accounting team and implementing financial strategies that align with the company’s goals Position Responsibilities: Manage financial close processes, ensuring accurate and timely reporting of project budgets and PoC. Oversee project accounting, A/R, A/P, and installer payroll operations. Implement and maintain internal financial controls. Oversee compliance with industry standards and government regulations, ensuring TCC maintains a strong reputation for ethical and legal financial practices. Provide accurate and timely reporting to senior management and stakeholders, ensuring full transparency of financial performance and key metrics. Support the CFO in managing external accounting services, including tax preparation, audits, and insurance renewals. Monitor and manage cash flow, ensuring the organization has adequate liquidity to meet operational needs and strategic initiatives. Maintain accurate WIP schedules, tracking costs, revenues, and project profitability. Conduct variance analysis to ensure project budgets and actuals align. Regularly reconcile job costs, revenue, and expenses. Additional projects assigned by CFO. Perform financial analysis, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, and P&L forecasting. Collaborate closely with your Strategic CFO team and client personnel. Be available virtually during normal business hours (Monday-Friday) via Microsoft Teams with camera on. Travel to Houston, Texas for onboarding. Travel to client locations in the United States approximately once per quarter. Perform other accounting and finance responsibilities as assigned. Qualifications: CPA, Contador Público, or Chartered Accountant required. 10+ years of progressive accounting experience. Must have recent construction/Project experience, POC /WIP Previous Controller or CFO experience required. Strong technical accounting knowledge, including U.S. GAAP. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, etc.). Excellent written and verbal English communication skills . Strong organizational and problem-solving skills. Collaborative team player with a hands-on attitude. Required Travel Documentation Experience with Dynamics 365/Business Central is a PLUS Applicants must meet all of the following requirements at the time of application: Valid passport. Current U.S. visa that permits travel to the United States. Ability to travel to Houston, Texas for onboarding and quarterly thereafter. Please do not apply unless you currently have both a valid passport and a valid U.S. visa.

review_candidates.title: Chef de Projet - Travaux maritimes et terrestres H/F
review_candidates.location: Communauté urbaine de Kribi, South, Cameroon
review_candidates.description: Constitué d'un groupe d'actionnaires camerounais, de Africa Global Logistics, de CMA CGM et de CHEC, le consortium Kribi Conteneurs Terminal est le concessionnaire du terminal à conteneurs du port en eaux profondes de Kribi. KCT offre à la chaîne logistique camerounaise une infrastructure moderne, adaptée à la nouvelle génération de navires transocéaniques, dont des quais de 350 mètres pouvant accueillir des navires ayant une capacité allant jusqu'à 11 000 EVP.Les infrastructures et les équipements sont conformes aux meilleurs standards internationaux. Véritable porte d'entrée sur le Cameroun et ses pays de l'hinterland, comme le Tchad ou la République Centrafricaine, ce nouveau terminal est appelé à faciliter l'essor du commerce régional et accélérer la croissance économique du pays. Kribi Conteneurs Terminal souhaite également se positionner comme un hub de transbordement. KRIBI CONTENEURS TERMINAL, une fenêtre sur l'Afrique ! Localisation du poste : KRIBI MISSIONS Intégré(e) au sein de l'équipe opérationnelle de Kribi Conteneur Terminal et rattaché fonctionnellement à la Direction Immobilier et Construction au siège du groupe AGL à Puteaux (92) - qui assure la maitrise d'ouvrage des projets d'infrastructures pour le compte des entités opérationnelles. Le/la Chef de Projet sera le représentant du Maitre d'Ouvrage dans le cadre d'un projet d'extension et de construction d'une plateforme de stockage intégrant la réalisation d'un terre-plein attenant de 8 ha sur terre. Il/Elle aura également la charge du suivi et de la coordination avec les parties prenantes à l'étude de faisabilité pour l'extension du terminal Phase 3. Ce projet est à fort enjeu vis-à-vis des autorités, il est donc primordial que le planning - 14 mois - et le budget soient strictement maitrisés. Il interviendra aux différentes phases du projet en défendant les intérêts du maitre d'ouvrage à chacune des étapes du projet : -Pilotage du projet : assurer le démarrage des travaux, leur exécution dans les délais et le respect du budget. -Suivi des autorisations nécessaires à la réalisation des travaux et interaction avec les différentes parties prenantes externes (administrations, autorités) et internes. -Phase Travaux : pilotage du projet, suivi des travaux, supervision de la PMC et coordination des différentes parties prenantes (entreprises, PMC, maître d'ouvrage, autorités, etc.). -Il sera spécifiquement en charge du pilotage technique, administratif et financier du ou des marchés de travaux, avec le soutien de la PMC. -Mise en service et exploitation du projet : pilotage des processus administratifs liés aux autorisations et licences pendant la phase d'exploitation, incluant l'animation des interlocuteurs internes et externes. -Suivi des appels d'offres pour la construction de bâtiments d'exploitation d'installations portuaires, en identifiant des exigences pour chaque construction -Pilotage des travaux de bâtiment, du démarrage à la mise en service, en respectant le budget et les délais clés. PROFIL Environ 15 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans la gestion de grands projets de construction à l'international et en particulier dans des environnements maritimes. Cette expérience est issue de missions en Entreprise de travaux et/ou en Maitrise d'oeuvre d'exécution principalement. Une expérience significative en Afrique serait un élément favorisant. -Formation Bac+5 type Ecole d'Ingénieur ou équivalent ; -Parfaite connaissance de travaux maritimes et portuaires & des contrats FIDIC ; -Maitrise de l'Anglais dans un cadre professionnel ; -Excellente maitrise des processus d'appel d'offres internationaux et des négociations technico-financières ; -Bonne connaissance des travaux de génie civil, terre-pleins, chaussée lourde ; -Grande capacité d'adaptation dans le cadre de projets internationaux et dans un environnement multiculturel ; -Capacité à travailler sous pression et dans des délais contraints ; -Sens du contact, de l'écoute et du dialogue particulièrement développé afin de collaborer pleinement avec les opérationnels et les autres intervenants dans la résolution des problèmes intégrant des problématiques multifactorielles.
